description: Project-scoped Agent aggregate with CRUD: backend grain + persistence, HTTP API, and mo agent CLI.

tasks.title: Agent aggregate, AgentGrain, and persistence with EF migration
tasks.description: Implement the Agent domain entity (id, projectId, name, description, instructions, agentConfig, skills, maxConcurrentRuns, status, createdAt, updatedAt; no execution/workflow fields), IAgentGrain/AgentGrain using a project-scoped key `projectId:agentId` mirroring EpicGrain (IStateStore<Agent> + OnActivateAsync load), AgentStore, AgentRow + MohistDbContext registration (JSON State + computed ProjectId/Name/Status columns + UNIQUE(ProjectId,Name) index mirroring IssueRow), AgentQuerier/AgentInfo, and the AddAgentsTable EF migration. Register IStateStore<Agent> in MohistServiceRegistration.cs.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent entity carries id, projectId, name, description, instructions, agentConfig, skills, maxConcurrentRuns, status, createdAt, updatedAt and contains no workflow-stage, run, worktree, or branch fields

AgentGrain key encodes projectId:agentId (via a new GrainKey.Agent helper) and loads state via IStateStore<Agent> on activation; two agents with the same agentId in different projects activate as distinct grains
Grain methods cover create/show/update/archive and reject duplicate names project-wide including archived rows (name-conflict error); rename applies the same uniqueness check
Soft delete (archive) sets status=archived and never removes the row; an archived name remains permanently occupied (create with that name still fails)

instructions stored byte-identical verbatim with no template rendering; agentConfig stored as opaque JSON (well-formed JSON validated only); BuildAgentConfig, IssueVariableBuilder, and IssueInfo.AgentConfig remain untouched
skills and maxConcurrentRuns persisted as declarative metadata with no runner-side consumption or enforcement in this layer
Agents table created via EF migration with a UNIQUE(ProjectId, Name) composite index and no foreign key to Issues
`dotnet ef database update` applies the migration and `dotnet ef database update <previous>` rolls it back cleanly, leaving Issues and all other tables unchanged
Grain unit tests cover create/show/update/archive/name-uniqueness (including archived-name-occupied) paths
dotnet build and the server test suite pass with the new aggregate
tasks.output: Agent entity, IAgentGrain/AgentGrain, AgentStore, AgentRow + DbContext config, AgentQuerier/AgentInfo, AddAgentsTable migration, IStateStore<Agent> DI registration, and grain unit tests
tasks.notes: Mirror EpicGrain.cs for the project-scoped key parsing and IssueStore.cs/IssueRow.cs for the JSON-blob + computed-column persistence. Per design D1, D2, D3, D6, D7, D8.

tasks.title: HTTP API /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents CRUD route group
tasks.description: Add AgentDefinitionRoutes mounted at /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents (plural, to avoid clashing with the existing singular /agent runtime route) using ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter and GetResolvedProject(). Implement POST/GET/GET{id}/PATCH/DELETE handlers with request/response DTOs, status filtering (default active, ?all=true, ?status=archived), name-conflict-to-409 mapping via the SQLite unique constraint violation, immutable-field rejection, and cross-project 404 isolation. Mount via a new MapAgentDefinitionRoutes() call in MohistApiRegistration.cs.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents creates an active Agent and returns 201 with the created record incl. generated id, createdAt, updatedAt
POST returns 400 when project context is missing and 409 on a duplicate name (active or archived) with no Agent created
GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents defaults to status=active, supports ?all=true (active+archived) and ?status=archived, and is project-scoped (no cross-project leakage)
GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents/{id} returns the full record incl. createdAt/updatedAt, reads archived Agents by id, and returns 404 for unknown or cross-project ids

PATCH /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents/{id} updates mutable fields (name, description, instructions, agentConfig, skills, maxConcurrentRuns), refreshes updatedAt, rejects changes to createdAt/id/projectId, returns 409 on a rename conflict, and 404 for unknown ids

DELETE /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents/{id} soft-archives (status=archived), refreshes updatedAt, does not remove the row; the name stays occupied (subsequent create with that name returns 409); 404 for unknown or cross-project ids
HTTP integration tests cover each endpoint and the 409/404 paths, including archived-name-occupied after DELETE
dotnet build and the API test suite pass
tasks.output: AgentDefinitionRoutes (+ DTOs), MapAgentDefinitionRoutes mount in MohistApiRegistration.cs, and HTTP integration tests
tasks.notes: Use plural /agents under the project group (design D4). Treat the UNIQUE(ProjectId,Name) DB index as the authoritative uniqueness guard and map its violation to 409 (design D7). agentConfig is validated as well-formed JSON only (design D5).

tasks.title: mo agent CLI command group (create/list/show/update/delete)
tasks.description: Add MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs registering a top-level `mo agent` command group with create/list/show/update/delete subcommands using System.CommandLine and the shared MohistCliApi.Print*Async. Reuse BodyInputResolver for --instructions (literal / @file / --instructions-stdin). Support --all and --status filters on list, name-or-id resolution on show/update/delete (client-side via the list/show endpoint), and clear 409-conflict / 404-not-found error surfacing. Register via root.Subcommands.Add(AgentCommands.Build(api)) in MohistCliCommands.cs.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo agent --help` lists create, list, show, update, delete subcommands; all subcommands require the server and surface 'Server is not running' with non-zero exit when unavailable

`mo agent create` requires --name and --instructions, accepts optional --description / --agent-config <json|@file> / --skills <csv> / --max-concurrent-runs <int>, accepts --instructions as literal / @file / --instructions-stdin, prints the agent id on success, surfaces 409 name conflict clearly, and exits 1 on missing required fields
`mo agent list` defaults to active Agents, `--all` includes archived, and `--status <value>` filters to a single status
`mo agent show <name-or-id>` resolves name or id, prints the full record incl. createdAt/updatedAt, and exits non-zero with a clear not-found error for unknown Agents

`mo agent update <name-or-id>` supports --name (subject to uniqueness, surfacing 409 on conflict), --description, --instructions, --agent-config, --skills, --max-concurrent-runs, and reflects the refreshed updatedAt
`mo agent delete <name-or-id>` soft-archives and states the Agent was archived; the deleted name cannot be reused (create fails with conflict)
CLI tests cover each subcommand and the conflict/not-found error surfacing
dotnet build and the CLI test suite pass
tasks.output: MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs, registration in MohistCliCommands.cs, and CLI tests
tasks.notes: Mirror MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs structure (design D9). Reuse BodyInputResolver verbatim for --instructions; it is already body-agnostic.
